subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When the operator records a local draft-lock review, the system shall retain a closed, versioned receipt binding proposal identity and kind, proposal-record full OID and monotonic sequence, operation draft-lock, branch ref, exact full prepared-head SHA, workflow-derived fully qualified mainline target ref and its existing full SHA, readiness digest, and a unique request nonce. It shall publish that receipt once, revalidate it against the current pre-landing proposal, and retain its canonical bytes and digest with the final proposal and lock evidence.
rationale: Prevents normal-route stale and same-origin replay errors and preserves clone-visible evidence after the review worktree is gone
fit_criterion: Real bare-origin fixtures reject missing, malformed, wrong-proposal, wrong-operation, wrong-branch, wrong-head, wrong-target, wrong-digest, and wrong-generation receipts without advancing landing refs; a nonce cannot be overwritten; retry after a completed landing recognizes the original result instead of creating a second lock; a fresh clone detects missing or changed retained receipt bytes and reports consistency with unauthenticated actor and origin identity.
